items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA and partners launch Open Secure AI Alliance for open AI cyber defense
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 與夥伴啟動 Open Secure AI Alliance，推動開放 AI 網路防禦
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced the Open Secure AI Alliance on July 27 with Microsoft, SpaceXAI (xAI), Hugging Face, IBM, Linux Foundation, Cognition, CrowdStrike and dozens of others. The coalition will develop and share open models, harnesses, tools and techniques so defenders can inspect, adapt and run frontier AI on their own infrastructure. NVIDIA is contributing open models, weights, data and the new NOOA agent framework on GitHub.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 於 7 月 27 日宣布成立 Open Secure AI Alliance，夥伴包括 Microsoft、SpaceXAI（xAI）、Hugging Face、IBM、Linux Foundation、Cognition、CrowdStrike 等數十家機構。聯盟將開發並共享開放模型、工具與技術，讓防禦方能在自有基礎設施上檢查、調整並運行前沿 AI。NVIDIA 貢獻開放模型、權重、資料與新的 NOOA agent 框架。
items_flat.analysis_en: The alliance is a direct industry response to recent closed-model agent incidents. By excluding the major closed labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) it signals a clear industry split between open defensive tooling and proprietary frontier systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此聯盟直接回應近期封閉模型 agent 事件。排除主要封閉實驗室（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）凸顯產業在開放防禦工具與專有前沿系統之間的明確分裂。
items_flat.quote: Attackers have frontier AI. Defenders need a frontier AI ecosystem—the best open and closed models, force-multiplied by a global community.
items_flat.quote_zh: 攻擊者已有前沿 AI。防禦者需要前沿 AI 生態系——最佳的開放與封閉模型，並由全球社群放大力量。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA and Safe Superintelligence Inc. announce long-term partnership with investment and Vera Rubin access
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 Safe Superintelligence Inc. 宣布長期合作，投資並提供 Vera Rubin 算力
items_flat.summary_en: On July 27 NVIDIA and Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) announced a long-term strategic partnership. NVIDIA is making a substantial investment and providing access to its Vera Rubin platform, expanding SSI’s compute by an order of magnitude. The companies will also collaborate on technical advancement of NVIDIA’s current and future compute platforms.
items_flat.summary_zh: 7 月 27 日，NVIDIA 與 Ilya Sutskever 創辦的 Safe Superintelligence Inc.（SSI）宣布長期戰略合作。NVIDIA 進行實質投資並提供 Vera Rubin 平台存取權，使 SSI 算力擴大一個數量級。雙方也將合作推進 NVIDIA 現有與未來運算平台的技術進展。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a major compute and capital commitment to a stealth, alignment-focused lab outside the main closed-model players. It diversifies NVIDIA’s frontier partnerships and gives SSI the scale needed to test its research direction.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對主要封閉模型玩家之外、以對齊為導向的隱密實驗室的重大算力與資本承諾。它讓 NVIDIA 的前沿合作更分散，並賦予 SSI 驗證其研究方向所需的規模。
items_flat.quote: We have research that is worthy of scaling up, and having access to a big NVIDIA computer will let us do so.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們有值得擴大規模的研究，能取得大型 NVIDIA 電腦將讓我們做到這一點。

items_flat.title_en: Moonshot AI releases full open weights for Kimi K3, the largest open-weight model
items_flat.title_zh: Moonshot AI 釋出 Kimi K3 完整開放權重，史上最大開放權重模型
items_flat.summary_en: Moonshot AI made the full weights of its 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 (MoE, ~104B active, 1M context, native multimodal) available for public download on Hugging Face on July 27 under the Kimi K3 License. The model was previously available via API and is described as the world’s first open 3T-class system.
items_flat.summary_zh: Moonshot AI 於 7 月 27 日在 Hugging Face 公開釋出 2.8 兆參數 Kimi K3（MoE、約 1040 億活躍參數、100 萬上下文、原生多模態）的完整權重，採 Kimi K3 License。該模型先前僅透過 API 提供，被稱為全球首個開放的 3T 級系統。
items_flat.analysis_en: At true frontier scale this is the largest open-weight release to date and materially expands the pool of high-capability models that can be self-hosted or fine-tuned, intensifying competition between open and closed ecosystems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以真正前沿規模而言，這是迄今最大的開放權重釋出，實質擴大可自建或微調的高能力模型池，加劇開放與封閉生態系的競爭。
items_flat.quote: We release the full Kimi K3 model weights to facilitate future research and accelerate the broader deployment and adoption of frontier intelligence.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們釋出完整 Kimi K3 模型權重，以促進未來研究並加速前沿智慧的更廣泛部署與採用。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes its position on open-weights models
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 公布對開放權重模型的立場
items_flat.summary_en: On July 27 Anthropic released “Our position on open-weights models,” stating it has never advocated a blanket ban. Non-dangerous open-weights models are a public good, but powerful ones carry higher irreversible misuse risks because weights cannot be withdrawn. It recommends chip export controls, cracking down on industrial-scale distillation, and mandatory safety testing for all sufficiently capable models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 7 月 27 日發布「我們對開放權重模型的立場」，表示從未主張全面禁止。非危險的開放權重模型是公共財，但強大模型因權重無法撤回而具有更高不可逆濫用風險。建議加強晶片出口管制、打擊工業級蒸餾，並對所有足夠強大的模型強制安全測試。
items_flat.analysis_en: Coming amid the Open Secure AI Alliance launch and industry pressure over open models, the statement positions Anthropic as favoring targeted controls rather than bans while defending the dual-use risks of frontier open weights.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在 Open Secure AI Alliance 啟動與產業對開放模型壓力之際，此聲明將 Anthropic 定位為支持針對性管控而非全面禁止，同時強調前沿開放權重的雙用風險。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic has never advocated for a ban on open-weights models.
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 從未主張禁止開放權重模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes research on AI-driven task crossover across occupations
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 AI 驅動跨職業任務交叉研究
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released the report “Work at the Frontier: How AI is Expanding What People Do at Work” analyzing more than 800,000 U.S. ChatGPT work-related messages. It finds 16.8% of work-related and 43.5% of occupation-specific messages involve tasks associated with another occupation, documenting early empirical patterns of AI expanding job boundaries.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布報告「Work at the Frontier: How AI is Expanding What People Do at Work」，分析超過 80 萬則美國 ChatGPT 工作相關訊息。發現 16.8% 的工作相關訊息與 43.5% 的職業特定訊息涉及其他職業的任務，記錄 AI 擴張工作邊界的早期實證模式。
items_flat.analysis_en: The data-driven framing of task crossover provides one of the clearest early empirical signals of how generative AI is already reshaping occupational boundaries inside real workplaces.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以數據為基礎的任務交叉框架，提供生成式 AI 已在真實職場重塑職業邊界的最清晰早期實證訊號之一。
items_flat.quote: In an analysis of more than 800,000 messages from U.S. ChatGPT users, our new research suggests that 16.8% of work-related messages and 43.5% of occupation-specific messages are about tasks associated with another occupation.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在對超過 80 萬則美國 ChatGPT 用戶訊息的分析中，我們的新研究顯示 16.8% 的工作相關訊息與 43.5% 的職業特定訊息涉及其他職業的任務。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic and Cognizant expand partnership; Cognizant becomes Global Premier Partner
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 與 Cognizant 擴大合作；Cognizant 成為全球首席合作夥伴
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic and Cognizant announced an expanded strategic partnership on July 27 making Cognizant one of a small number of Global Premier Partners in the Claude Partner Network. Cognizant is embedding Claude across its industry platforms (Flowsource, Neuro AI Engineering, Neuro IT Ops), has trained more than 30,000 associates, and is deploying Claude in manufacturing, life sciences and insurance client systems.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 與 Cognizant 於 7 月 27 日宣布擴大戰略合作，使 Cognizant 成為 Claude Partner Network 少數全球首席合作夥伴之一。Cognizant 正將 Claude 嵌入其產業平台（Flowsource、Neuro AI Engineering、Neuro IT Ops），已訓練超過 3 萬名員工，並在製造、生命科學與保險客戶系統中部署 Claude。
items_flat.analysis_en: Elevating a major systems integrator to the top tier accelerates Claude’s path into regulated enterprise workflows and gives Anthropic a stronger channel against competitors already embedded with large IT services firms.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將大型系統整合商提升至最高層級，加速 Claude 進入受監管企業工作流程，並為 Anthropic 在大型 IT 服務公司已嵌入的競爭中提供更強通路。
items_flat.quote: Deepening our partnership with Cognizant will help more companies harness AI's growing capability and deploy it in real, practical ways for their businesses.
items_flat.quote_zh: 深化與 Cognizant 的合作將幫助更多公司運用 AI 不斷增長的能力，並以真實實用的方式部署於業務中。

items_flat.title_en: Meta announces nearly $2M AI Glasses Impact Grant recipients
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 公布近 200 萬美元 AI 眼鏡影響力補助金得主
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced the recipients of its AI Glasses Impact Grants on July 27, awarding nearly $2 million to 30 U.S. organizations and developers using Meta AI glasses (Ray-Ban Meta) for accessibility, workforce safety, education, agriculture and economic opportunity across 18 states.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 7 月 27 日公布 AI 眼鏡影響力補助金得主，向 30 個美國組織與開發者發放近 200 萬美元，支持其使用 Meta AI 眼鏡（Ray-Ban Meta）於無障礙、職場安全、教育、農業與經濟機會等領域，涵蓋 18 州。
items_flat.analysis_en: The grants reinforce Meta’s strategy of seeding real-world developer and nonprofit use cases for its AI glasses platform, turning hardware into a distribution channel for applied AI.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 補助金強化 Meta 為 AI 眼鏡平台播種真實開發者與非營利應用案例的策略，將硬體轉化為應用 AI 的分發管道。
items_flat.quote: We’re announcing the recipients of the AI Glasses Impact Grants – 30 organizations across the US using Meta AI glasses to help people work safer, learn faster, and live more independently.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們公布 AI 眼鏡影響力補助金得主——全美 30 個組織正使用 Meta AI 眼鏡協助人們更安全工作、更快學習、更獨立生活。

brief_zh: NVIDIA 推出開放安全 AI 聯盟（排除主要封閉實驗室）並與 Ilya Sutskever 的 SSI 達成 Vera Rubin 算力合作。Anthropic 澄清不主張全面禁止開放權重模型。Moonshot 釋出 Kimi K3 完整開放權重（2.8T）。OpenAI 研究量化 AI 跨職業任務交叉；Anthropic 將 Cognizant 提升為全球首席合作夥伴；Meta 公布 AI 眼鏡影響力補助金。
